record.original_question: If X is a non-pseudocompact space, must there exist a point p in βX that is not the limit of any countable discrete nowhere dense subset of X?

evidence.quote: Question 4. If X is a non-pseudocompact space does there exist a point p ∈ βX which is not the limit of any countable discrete nowhere dense set?
The main diﬃculty is in producing a point of βX − X which is not the limit of any countable discrete subset of X (an ω-far point in van Douwen [1981]).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Tychonoff (completely regular Hausdorff) topological space, and let $\beta X$ denote its Stone–Čech compactification. Recall that $X$ is pseudocompact if every continuous real-valued function on $X$ is bounded. A subset $D \subseteq X$ is said to be discrete if every point of $D$ is isolated in the subspace topology of $D$, and nowhere dense in $X$ if its closure in $X$ has empty interior. A point $p \in \beta X$ is called a limit of a set $A \subseteq X$ if $p$ lies in the closure of $A$ in $\beta X$ but $p \notin A$. Call $p \in \beta X$ an $\omega$-far point of $X$ if $p$ is not a limit of any countable discrete nowhere dense subset of $X$.

Question: If $X$ is not pseudocompact, must there exist a point $p \in \beta X$ that is an $\omega$-far point of $X$, i.e., a point of $\beta X$ which is not the limit of any countable discrete nowhere dense subset of $X$?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned related work on remote points, ω-far points, and van Douwen's questions on βX, but no definitive resolution of this specific question for arbitrary non-pseudocompact spaces was located. Existence results are known under additional hypotheses (e.g., countable π-weight), but the general question's status could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.snippet: Collection of van Douwen's open problems including questions on ω-far points in βX.
status_evidence.claim: The question on ω-far points originates with van Douwen and is listed among his collected open problems, suggesting it has not been settled in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Remote points in large products
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses existence of remote points in βX for various non-pseudocompact spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of remote/far-type points is established under restrictions such as countable π-weight, but not in full generality for all non-pseudocompact spaces.
